name: Lone Tree Campground
note: City of Powers Lake campground at the boat ramp and dock on the lake's south-east shore, across the railway at the south end of 90th Ave NW: a short gravel spur on open grass with a small building and a vault toilet. The city publishes nothing about this campground (no rate, season or hookups), so call its parks contact to confirm it is open before going. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: ND HHS Statewide Licensed RV Parks/Campgrounds (updated 07.17.2025; hhs.nd.gov .../statewide-licensed-rv-parks-campgrounds-exception.pdf, read 2026-11-12) row 236: LONE TREE CAMPGROUND, 90TH AVE NW, Powers Lake, Burke County, owner POWERS LAKE CITY PARK FUND, First District Health Unit, licence to 12/31/2025, last inspection 8/21/2023, 8 lots -> an agency document naming it as a licensed campground (public ladder step 1). Location: 90th Ave NW (OSM way 9610387) ends at the railway crossing just above this lakeside spot (Nominatim reverse 2026-11-12), and ND Game and Fish's Powers Lake contour map (gf.nd.gov/gnf/maps/fishing/lakecontours/powers2019.pdf, 2019-20, read 2026-11-12) marks a boat ramp, vault toilet and fishing pier there on the south-east side of the lake. City of Powers Lake Local Attractions page (powerslakend.com, read 2026-11-12): 'There are two public campgrounds with electricity. The campgrounds over look the lake'; the HHS list has exactly two CAMPGROUND licences under the city's Park Fund (Lake Park 6 lots and Lone Tree 8 lots) beside the city's POWERS LAKE RV PARK (200 Lakeside Ave E, 16 lots), which the Parks & Rec page describes as its long-term RV park ($500-600/month) - consistent with Lone Tree being one of the two public campgrounds, though the city never names it. Esri imagery and Wayback captures 2017-08-10, 2020-07-16, 2021-07-04, 2024-05-12 (z18/z19 at 48.54995,-102.62600; 220 m and 600 m frames): a gravel road crosses the tracks to the ramp and dock, with a ~60 m gravel spur running north-west on open mown grass, a small building, an outhouse and planted tree rows; the 2017 capture shows a camper-sized white unit parked on the spur -> drive-in, open ground where a 23-ft rig fits; no posted limits or road warnings anywhere. No horse facilities or mention. Public (local): no price gate or presence rule. Not on RV Life (Algolia geo query 15 km, 2026-11-12: only 5981) and not on Google Maps (a search for it returned Lonetree WMA, 2026-11-12); no camper reviews found. Long-stay/workforce: no count of nightly vs long-term lots exists (test 4 passes on no count); the city's monthly park is the separate in-town RV park, and every capture 2017-2024 shows at most one camper here - not a workforce or residential park.
waterfront_evidence: 2026-11-12: Esri World Imagery (220 m frame at 48.54995,-102.62600; z19 tiles) and Wayback captures 2017-08-10, 2020-07-16, 2021-07-04 (z18). No site map, numbered-site positions or official photos exist. The gravel spur runs north-west from the ramp road ~28-40 m from Powers Lake's south-east shore across open mown grass, with a small building and outhouse in the grass between and a brushy bank (a row of shore trees by the building in 2017-2021) at the water's edge; the 2017 camper sat on the spur's inland (north-east) side, so the spur itself lies between it and the water; the ramp and its approach (day use) split the spur from the grass east of the ramp. No pad can be placed within ~50 m of the water with only open ground between -> no on-water site proven; the lake is in open view across the grass from the spur -> lakeview. Dam check: Powers Lake is a natural lake (G&F map shows only a water-control structure); DEM 668 m at the spur vs 666 m on the shore and G&F's 2019 summer level 2191.7 ft (668 m) -> level with the lake, not below a berm.

sites.note: 8 licensed lots; hookups and pad layout unpublished.

sites_source: ND HHS Statewide Licensed RV Parks/Campgrounds (updated 07.17.2025) row 236, LONE TREE CAMPGROUND, 8 lots, read 2026-11-12
facilities_source: https://gf.nd.gov/gnf/maps/fishing/lakecontours/powers2019.pdf (ND Game and Fish Powers Lake map, 2019-20: vault toilet symbol beside the boat ramp and fishing pier on the south-east side), read 2026-11-12; outhouse visible on Esri imagery 2024-05-12
flags: Thin evidence: existence rests on the 07.17.2025 HHS licence (8 lots, inspected 8/21/2023, owner Powers Lake City Park Fund) plus imagery and G&F's ramp/toilet map. The city's pages never name Lone Tree (only 'two public campgrounds with electricity ... over look the lake'), Burke County's visitors page lists only Lake Park and Smishek, and no review site or Google listing has it. Phone-list candidate if AWH wants it confirmed (operating in 2026, electric, rate, season).

Electric NOT written: the only source saying '12 RV sites with electric' is ndtourism (never a source). The city's 'two public campgrounds with electricity' probably includes it, but the city doesn't name them.

Phone 701-705-5369 is the City of Powers Lake parks contact (Parks & Rec page: RV parks and shelter reservations), not a Lone Tree-specific number. Website is the city's Parks & Rec page, which is silent on Lone Tree; no better official page exists (ndtourism refused/never used).

Separate from 5981 (not a duplicate): ~1.7 km apart; 5981 is the in-town lakeshore loop on Lakeside Ave, this is the south-east shore ramp reached by 90th Ave NW across the railway; separate HHS licences (LAKE PARK CAMPGROUND, Lakeside E Ave, 6 lots vs LONE TREE CAMPGROUND, 90th Ave NW, 8 lots).

For 5981: its published name appears to be 'Lake Park Campground' - Burke County visitors page (burkecountynd.com/visitors, read 2026-11-12): 'Lake Park Campground: 12 RV hookups, 8 with electricity. Located along the shore of the lake. Call for availability. (701) 705-5369'; HHS row 211 LAKE PARK CAMPGROUND, Lakeside E Ave, Powers Lake City Park Fund, 6 lots, inspected 8/21/2023. RV Life still calls it Powers Lake City Park (3*/$ on 2, 4 sites). The city's long-term monthly park is the separate POWERS LAKE RV PARK (200 Lakeside Ave E, City of Powers Lake, 16 lots).
Pin: ndtourism's point (48.549853,-102.625503) sits on the ramp approach; pinned to the middle of the gravel spur. Exactly where the 8 lots are is not published.
Waterfront: lakeview on imagery alone; on-water not supported because no pad position is known and the spur/ramp lie between the camping ground and the water.
curation_note: ND lead 14 (2026-11-12): separate from 5981 (own HHS licence LONE TREE CAMPGROUND, 90th Ave NW, 8 lots, vs LAKE PARK CAMPGROUND, Lakeside E Ave, 6 lots; both Powers Lake City Park Fund; ~1.7 km apart). Existence rests on that licence (to 12/31/2025, inspected 8/21/2023), G&F's ramp/vault-toilet map and imagery; the city never names it. Phone is the city's parks contact. --Claude
